name: Snake River — Astoria to Sheep Gulch (Snake River Canyon)
gaugeName: Snake River Above Reservoir, Near Alpine, WY (USGS 13022500)
blurb: Snake River Canyon from Astoria to Sheep Gulch, Bridger-Teton National Forest (permit-fee area).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Astoria (Snake): approximate area only. Take-out Prichard (Snake): exact agency facility pin. Bridger-Teton NF Snake River Special Recreation Permit area: within ¼ mile of each bank from the Hoback River confluence to 1 mile above the Alpine Junction Bridge. Bridger-Teton NF Snake River Canyon: "special use permits for non-commercial groups over 15 people and for institutional outfitters are required" (South Park Bridge to Sheep Gulch); launch at the existing ramps. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (1.0 mi); no agency mileage found.

notices.title: Snake River Canyon permits
notices.text: The Forest Service recreation fee applies May 1–November 1: $5 per vehicle per day, with season passes available. Non-commercial groups of 16–30 people need timed launch reservations May 1–October 1 for South Park Bridge–Sheep Gulch. Check the agency page before travel.
